summary: Safety follow-up to r0066 Monitoring self-health: supervision-marker persistence is now strictly best-effort (can't crash-loop the poller; armed-state gating stops repeated false unclean-restart events if persistence stays broken), and a failed/malformed systemd self-health probe is classified as systemd-unavailable rather than misreported as confirmed-inactive. Also a product-focused README.md rewrite -- no runtime behavior change from the doc edit.
